description: T1 item 9 (testbenches shipped) for the benches on main: the inverter DC and transient toolchain smokes. These are smoke benches, not claimed characterization numbers; every result they produce is SIMULATED, never measured. The five-corner requests ran on the batch fleet and their records are under sim/smoke/records/ (sim/smoke/README.md); the cold start runs the single-corner tt probe requests, which are the ones that reproduce locally from a clean checkout. Item-5 characterization benches are added by the PRs that land them.
